Run `make citations` after refreshing `data/studies.csv` to fetch latest citation counts.

```{sh cites}
make citations
```

```{r}
source("R/utils.R")

dbs_to_include = c("control", "privacy", "privacy_continuous", "error", "error_scaled", "margin")
sensitivity_db = c("sensitivity")
experiments_to_include = c(
  "control",
  "privacy",
  "privacy_continuous",
  "error",
  "error_scaled",
  "margin"
)
log_threshold(DEBUG)
```

```{r data}
study_metadata = load_study_metadata()
results_metadata = load_results_metadata()
variables_metadata = load_variables_metadata(results_metadata)

sensitivities = load_sensitivity(sensitivity_db)

noise = load_noise(experiments_to_include)
print_antijoin("%d variables with no noise (expected; these are constructed vars)", variables_metadata, noise, pk_variables)
print_antijoin("%d variables with no metadata (expected; these are component vars)", noise, variables_metadata, pk_variables)

results_latest = load_results(
  experiments_to_include,
  study_metadata,
  results_metadata,
  variables_metadata,
  noise,
  sensitivities
)
print_counts(
  "Final sample: %d results, %d studies", results_latest,
  save_num_studies="numStudies",
  save_num_results="numResults"
)

# Compute metrics
results_latest = results_latest %>%
  compute_error_metrics()

# Subsets for analysis
# DP only, no error
epsilon_abbrv <- c("1000", "100", "10", "1", "0.1", "0.01", "0.001", "0.0001")
results_latest_dp_extended = results_latest %>%
  filter((is_dp & !is_error & !is_mo) | is_control)
results_latest_dp = results_latest_dp_extended %>%
  filter(is_control | epsilon_str %in% epsilon_abbrv)
results_latest_laplace = results_latest_dp %>%
  filter(mechanism_str == "laplace" | is_control)
results_latest_gaussian = results_latest_dp %>%
  filter(mechanism_str == "gaussian" | is_control)
# error only, no DP
results_latest_error = results_latest %>%
  filter((is_error & !is_dp & !is_mo) | is_control)
results_latest_static = results_latest_error %>%
  filter((cscale_str == "static" & shrink_str == "Original") | is_control) %>%
  filter(shrink_b_str != "None, b=0.0") # this is just the same as None
results_latest_scaled = results_latest_error %>%
  filter((shrink_str == "None") | is_control)
# combined error + DP
results_latest_combined = results_latest %>%
  filter((is_error & !is_mo & shrink_str == "Hudson-Berger") | is_control)
# multiple overimputation
mo_epsilon_str <- as.vector(results_latest %>% filter(is_mo) %>% distinct(epsilon_str) %>% pull())
results_latest_dp_mo = results_latest %>%
  filter((is_dp & (epsilon_str %in% mo_epsilon_str)) | is_mo | is_control) %>%
  filter(mechanism_str != "gaussian") %>%
  group_by(across(all_of(pk_studies))) %>% mutate(
    has_results = !all(is_null_result[is_mo])
  ) %>%
  filter(has_results)
print_counts("MO sample: %d results, %d studies", results_latest_dp_mo)

# long version of JEL metadata
results_latest_jel = results_latest %>%
  select(study_id, jel_code) %>%
  distinct() %>% # jel code maps 1:1 to study, so this just drops dupes
  expand_jel()
results_latest_jel_1 = results_latest_jel %>%
  distinct(study_id, jel_code_1, jel_description_1_abbrv)
num_jel_studies = results_latest_jel %>% drop_na(jel_code_1) %>% distinct(study_id) %>% nrow()
log_info("Studies with JEL codes: {num_jel_studies}")
report("numStudiesJEL", num_jel_studies)
print_counts("Computed metrics for %d results from %d studies", results_latest)
```

```{r info}
# studies per year
results_latest %>% distinct(study_id, year) %>% count(year)
# studies per source
results_latest %>% distinct(study_id, source) %>% count(source)
results_latest %>% distinct(study_id, source, search_term) %>% count(source, search_term)

# unusual failures
show_failures = function(df) df %>% 
  select(all_of(pk_experiment_result_runs), est, p, est_original, p_original, expected_lb, expected_ub, starts_with("epistemic"))
little_noise_failures = results_latest_dp %>%
  filter(!epistemic_match & epsilon == 1000)
little_noise_failures %>% show_failures()
report("numResultsFailedEpsOneThousandLaplace", little_noise_failures %>% filter(mechanism_str == "laplace") %>% distinct(result_id) %>% nrow())
low_noise_failures = results_latest_dp %>%
  filter(!epistemic_match & epsilon == 100)
low_noise_failures %>% show_failures()
report("numResultsFailedEpsOneHundredLaplace", low_noise_failures %>% filter(mechanism_str == "laplace") %>% distinct(result_id) %>% nrow())
```

```{r sample-summary}
controls = results_latest %>%
  filter(is_control & sim_id == 1)

## numericals
# study
study_stats_df = controls %>%
  group_by(study_id) %>%
  summarise(
    "Years since publication" = first(years_since_publication),
    "Num. results replicated" = n_distinct(result_id),
    "Citations (Semantic Scholar)" = first(semantic_scholar_citation_count)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(-study_id))
study_stats_df %>% summ_stats()
num_results = study_stats_df %>% filter(name == "Num. results replicated") %>% pull(value)
report("numResultsRange", sprintf("%d--%d", num_results %>% quantile(0.25)
, num_results %>% quantile(0.75)))
report("maxYearsSincePub", study_stats_df %>% summ_stats(compact=F) %>% filter(name == "Years since publication") %>% slice(1L) %>% pull("Max.") %>% as.numeric() %>% round())

# result
result_stats = controls %>%
  select(
    study_id, result_id, df_model, n_vars_personal, prop_noised_success, avg_population_size, dv_rq_primary, claim_in_abstract, individual_level
    # starts_with("reg_role")
  ) %>%
  rename(
    any_of(varnames_lookup)
  ) %>%
  select(-starts_with("reg_role")) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(-study_id, -result_id)) %>%
  summ_stats()
result_stats
num_results_in_abstract = result_stats %>%
  filter(name == "Supports claim mentioned in abstract") %>% slice(1L) %>% pull("Obs.")
report("propResultsInAbstract", sprintf("%s of %s", num_results_in_abstract, get_report("numResults")))
  
# variables
cats = c("reg_role", "noised", "query_type_simple")
var_joined = controls %>%
  inner_join(variables_metadata, by=pk_results)
nvars = var_joined %>% distinct(study_id, variable_id) %>% nrow()
log_info("Used {nvars} vars in results")
report("numVars", nvars)
var_joined %>%
  distinct(across(c(study_id, variable_id, any_of(cats)))) %>%
  dummy_cols(select_columns=cats) %>%
  rename(
    any_of(varnames_lookup)
  ) %>%
  select(-starts_with(cats)) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(-study_id, -variable_id)) %>%
  summ_stats()
num_privatized = var_joined %>%
  distinct(study_id, variable_id, noised) %>%
  pull(noised) %>% sum()
print(num_privatized)
report("propVarsNotPrivatized", sprintf("%.1f", 100 * (1 - num_privatized / as.numeric(get_report("numVars")))), add_pct_sign = T)
report("numResultsNotFullyPrivatized", sprintf("%d", results_latest %>% filter(n_vars_noised != n_vars_personal) %>% distinct(study_id, result_id) %>% nrow()))

## categoricals
bar_count = list(
  geom_bar(),
  coord_flip(),
  scale_x_discrete(labels=function(x) str_wrap(x, width=25)),
  theme
)
# study
results_latest_jel_1 %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=fct_infreq(jel_description_1_abbrv))) +
    bar_count +
    ylab("# studies") +
    xlab("JEL Classification")
# results
controls %>%
  select(study_id, result_id, design, estimation_method, stata_cmd_abbrv) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(-study_id, -result_id)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=value)) +
    bar_count +
    ylab("# results") +
    facet_wrap(vars(name), scales="free_y")
# variables
controls %>%
  inner_join(variables_metadata, by=c("study_id", "result_id")) %>%
  select(study_id, result_id, variable_id, reg_role, data_type, query_type_simple) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(-study_id, -result_id, -variable_id)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=value)) +
    bar_count +
    ylab("# variables") +
    facet_wrap(vars(name), scales="free_y")
# top journals
results_latest %>%
  distinct(study_id, journal_abbrv) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=journal_abbrv %>% fct_infreq())) +
    bar_count +
    ylab("# studies") +
    xlab("Journal")
ggsave("plots/journals.pdf", width=5, height=7, dpi=300)
ggsave("plots/journals.png", width=5, height=7, dpi=300)
```
```{r variable-types}
# plot variables_metadata$query_type_abbrv as a categorical bar chart, but grouped by noised or not
labels = c("Not privatized", "Privatized")
plot_variable_type = function(df, var, wrap_labels=T) {
  plt = df %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=!!sym(var) %>% fct_infreq() %>% fct_rev(), fill=noised, color=noised)) +
    geom_bar(position="stack", alpha=1) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_manual(
      name="",
      values=c("TRUE"="#0072B2", "FALSE"="#E69F00"),
      labels=labels
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      name="",
      values=c("TRUE"="#0072B2", "FALSE"="#E69F00"),
      labels=labels
    ) +
    theme +
    ylab("# variables") +
    xlab("Query type")
  if (wrap_labels) {
    plt = plt + scale_x_discrete(labels=function(x) str_wrap(x, width=10, whitespace_only=F))
  }
  plt
}
variables_metadata %>%
  distinct(variable_id, query_type_simple, noised) %>%
  filter(!is.na(query_type_simple)) %>%
  plot_variable_type("query_type_simple")
ggsave("plots/query-type.pdf", width=5, height=3)
ggsave("plots/query-type.png", width=5, height=3)

variables_metadata %>%
  expand_data_domain() %>%
  distinct(variable_id, data_domain_abbrv, noised) %>%
  filter(!is.na(data_domain_abbrv)) %>%
  plot_variable_type("data_domain_abbrv", wrap_labels=F)
ggsave("plots/data-domain.pdf", width=5, height=4)
ggsave("plots/data-domain.png", width=5, height=4)

results_metadata %>%
  distinct(result_id, stata_cmd) %>%
  filter(!is.na(stata_cmd)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=stata_cmd %>% fct_infreq() %>% fct_rev())) +
  geom_bar(position="stack") +
  coord_flip() +
  theme +
  ylab("# findings") +
  xlab("Stata command used")
ggsave("plots/stata-cmd.pdf", width=3, height=4)
ggsave("plots/stata-cmd.png", width=3, height=4)
```

```{r viz-science}
results_latest_gaussian %>%
    results_means() %>%
    drop_na(r_stat_original, r_stat_mean, r_stat_se, epistemic_match_mean) %>%
    ggplot(aes(
      x=p_original,
      y=p_mean,
      ymin=ci_lb(p_mean, p_se, 0.1),
      ymax=ci_ub(p_mean, p_se, 0.1),
      color=epistemic_match_mean
    )) +
      geom_abline(slope=1, intercept=0, linetype="dashed", alpha=0.5) +
      xlab("Original p") +
      ylab("Avg. replication p") +

      scale_x_continuous(limits=c(0, 0.1)) +
      # geom_linerange() +
      color_scale +
      theme +
      theme(legend.position="top") +
    facet_wrap(vars(epsilon_str_eq), labeller=label_parsed, ncol=3)
```

```{r sensitivity}
results_latest_laplace_treatment = results_latest_laplace %>%
  filter(!is_control)
results_latest_laplace_treatment
# noise_laplace = results_latest_laplace_treatment %>%

  inner_join(noise_laplace, by=pk_sensitivity, suffix=c("", ".noise")) %>%
```

```{r viz-sankey}
# x=node -> next_x=next_node
# e.g. Original=small -> 1000=very small

results_latest_laplace %>%
  select(all_of(pk_results), sim_id, epsilon_str, r_stat_size) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols=c(pk_results, sim_id), names_from=epsilon_str, values_from=r_stat_size) %>%
  group_by(across(all_of(pk_results))) %>%
  mutate(Original=first(Original)) %>% # only one entry for Original by default, so impute the rest from the first row
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-all_of(pk_results), -sim_id) %>%
  plot_sankey() +
  ylab("# simulations") +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend("Effect size")
  )

results_latest_laplace %>%
  filter(epsilon_str == "Original" | (epsilon < 1000 & epsilon > 0.0001)) %>%
  results_means() %>%
  select(all_of(pk_results), epsilon_str, r_stat_mean_size) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols=pk_results, names_from=epsilon_str, values_from=r_stat_mean_size) %>%
  select(-all_of(pk_results)) %>%
  plot_sankey() +
  ylab("# results") +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      paste0("Average effect size (N=", results_latest_laplace %>% distinct(sim_id) %>% nrow(), ")"),
      ncol=2, title.position="top"
    )
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position="top"
  )
ggsave("plots/sankey_laplace.pdf", dpi=300, width=5.5, height=6)
ggsave("plots/sankey_laplace.png", dpi=300, width=5.5, height=6)
```

```{r viz-examples, fig.height=12}
plot_examples = function(df, example_studies, suffix=NULL, ...) {
  if (is.null(suffix)) {
    suffix = ""
  } else {
    suffix = paste0("_", suffix)
  }
  examples = df %>%
    filter(study_id %in% example_studies) %>%
    filter((epsilon > 0.0001 & epsilon < 1000) | is_control)
  results_formatted = examples %>%
    group_by(
      across(all_of(pk_results)), epsilon_str
    ) %>%
    summarise_all(first)

  results_formatted %>%
    plot_results("free_y")
  ggsave(sprintf("plots/cis%s.pdf", suffix), dpi=300, ...)
  ggsave(sprintf("plots/cis%s.png", suffix), dpi=300, ...)
  
  examples %>%
    results_means() %>%
    plot_results_tile()
  ggsave(sprintf("plots/tile%s.pdf", suffix), dpi=300, ...)
  ggsave(sprintf("plots/tile%s.png", suffix), dpi=300, ...)
}
example_studies = c(
  "autor-2013", "ferraz-2011", "topalova-2010", "wilson-2012"
  # "allison-2023"
)
results_latest_dp %>% plot_examples(c(
  "autor-2013", "ferraz-2011", "topalova-2010", "wilson-2012"
))

# appendix examples
results_latest_dp %>%
  mutate(
    study_id_abbrv = replace(study_id_abbrv, study_id_abbrv == "Al'23", "St'23"),
    row_label = case_when(
      str_starts(row_label, "Al'23") ~ str_replace(row_label, "Al'23", "St'23"),
      TRUE ~ row_label
    )
  ) %>%
  plot_examples(
    c("guidetti-2021", "allison-2023"), suffix="guidetti", width=7, height=7
  )
```

```{r metrics}
## non-CI metrics
num_trials_for = function(df) {
  (df %>% distinct(study_id, result_id) %>% nrow()) *
    (df %>% distinct(sim_id) %>% nrow())
}
ylabel_for = function(df) ylab(paste0("Rate (N=", num_trials_for(df), ")"))
yscale_for = function(df) list(scale, ylabel_for(df))
results_latest_dp %>%
  filter(!is_control) %>%
  get_metrics_long() %>%
  dot_means("value", "epsilon_str_latex", "name", "free_y", sample_sizes=F, ncol=2, colorvar="mechanism_str", colorlabels=mechanism_expressions, freq_order=F, report_name="") +
    ylabel_for(results_latest_dp) +
    xlab(expression(epsilon)) +
  guides(
    color=guide_legend("Mechanism"),
    shape=guide_legend("Mechanism")
  )
ggsave("plots/metrics.pdf", dpi=300, height=6)
ggsave("plots/metrics.png", dpi=300, height=6)
report("numTrialsTotal", sprintf("%d", num_trials_for(results_latest_dp)))

    "value", "epsilon_str_latex", "name", "free_y",

    report_name="PerfectPriv"
  ) +
```

```{r metrics compact}
## CI metrics, alpha fixed
alpha_thresh = 0.05
lb = 0.3
scale = scale_y_continuous(
  limits=c(lb, 1.0),
  # breaks=c(1.0, 1-alpha, 0.8, 0.6, 0.4, 0.2, 0.0),
  breaks=c(1.0, 0.8, 0.6, 0.4, 0.2, 0.0),
  # labels=c(1.0, expression(1-alpha), 0.8, 0.6, 0.4, 0.2, 0.0)
  labels=c(1.0, 0.8, 0.6, 0.4, 0.2, 0.0)
)
scale_margin = scale_y_continuous(
  limits=c(-1+lb, 0.0),
  # breaks=c(-1, -0.8, -0.6, -0.4, -0.2, -alpha, 0.0),
  breaks=c(-1, -0.8, -0.6, -0.4, -0.2, 0.0),
  # labels=c(-1, -0.8, -0.6, -0.4, -0.2, expression(alpha), 0.0)
  labels=c(-1, -0.8, -0.6, -0.4, -0.2, 0.0)
)
formatting = list(
  theme(
    legend.title = ggtext::element_markdown(),
    legend.justification = c("left", "top"),
    legend.box.margin=margin(0, 0, -10, 0),
    plot.margin=margin(l=5)
  )
)
epsilonlabel = list(
  xlab(expression(epsilon)),
  theme(axis.title.x=element_text(size=15))
)

privacy_plot = function(df, title) df %>%
  dot_means("value", "epsilon_str_latex", "name", "free_y", sample_sizes=F, compact=T, ncol=1, colorvar="mechanism_str", colorlabels=mechanism_expressions, freq_order=F, hlines=hlines) +
  yscale_for(df) +
  epsilonlabel +
  guides(
    color=guide_legend(title, ncol=1, title.position="top"),
    shape=guide_legend(title, ncol=1, title.position="top"),
    linetype="none"
  ) +
  formatting
privacy_df = results_latest_dp %>%
  format_treatments() %>%
  get_metrics_long_alpha() %>%
  filter(alpha == alpha_thresh, !is_control, epsilon < 1000, epsilon > 0.0001)
privacy = privacy_df %>%
  privacy_plot("**Privacy noise alone**<br><br>Mechanism")
privacy_perfect = privacy_df %>%
  filter(n_vars_noised == n_vars_personal) %>%
  privacy_plot("**Privacy noise alone**<br>(all personal vars. privatized)<br><br>Mechanism")
privacy_sens_lte_1 = privacy_df %>%
  filter(n_sens_gt_1 < 1) %>%
  privacy_plot("**Privacy noise alone**<br>(no sens. > 1)<br><br>Mechanism")
privacy_data_ind = privacy_df %>%
  filter(n_data_dependent_bounds < 1) %>%
  privacy_plot("**Privacy noise alone**<br>(data ind. bounds only)<br><br>Mechanism")

title = "**Data error alone**<br><br>Construction"
scaled_df = results_latest_error %>%
  filter(b_str == "None" | b == 0.0) %>%
  get_metrics_long_alpha() %>%
  filter(alpha == alpha_thresh, !is_control)
scaled = scaled_df %>%
  dot_means("value", "a", "name", "free_y", sample_sizes=F, compact=T, ncol=1, colorvar="shrink_b_str", freq_order=F, hlines=hlines) +
  yscale_for(scaled_df) +
  xlab("Coefficient of variation (CV)") +
  guides(
    color=guide_legend(title, ncol=1, title.position="top"),
    shape=guide_legend(title, ncol=1, title.position="top"),
    linetype="none"
  ) +
  formatting +
  theme(axis.title.y=element_blank()) # don't need axis title for middle plot
subtitle = "**Data error (Hudson-**<br>**Berger) +**<br>**privacy noise (Gaussian)**<br><br>Data error CV"
margin_df = results_latest_combined %>%
  format_treatments() %>%
  filter((mechanism_str != "laplace" & shrink_str == "Hudson-Berger") | is_control) %>%
  filter(a %in% c(0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 0.8) | is_control) %>%
  get_metrics_long_alpha(margin=T) %>%
  filter(alpha == alpha_thresh, !is_control, epsilon < 1000, epsilon > 0.0001)
margin = margin_df %>%
  dot_means("value", "epsilon_str_latex", "name", "free_y", sample_sizes=F, compact=T, ncol=1, colorvar="a_str", freq_order=F, report_name="GaussianAlphaTen") +
  scale_margin +
  ylab("Avg. marginal impact of privacy mech.") +
  epsilonlabel +
  guides(
    color=guide_legend(subtitle, ncol=3, title.position="top"),
    shape=guide_legend(subtitle, ncol=3, title.position="top")
  ) +
  formatting
# shared legend https://wilkelab.org/cowplot/articles/shared_legends.html
legend = cowplot::get_legend(
  privacy + guides(
    linetype=guide_legend(hline_title, ncol=2, title.position="left"),
    color="none",
    shape="none"
  ) + theme(
    legend.justification="center",
    legend.title.justification="right",
    plot.margin=margin(0,0,0,0)
  )
)
plots = c(
  "all"=privacy + scaled + margin,
  "dperror"=privacy + scaled,
  "margin"=privacy + margin,
  "privacy-perfect"=privacy + privacy_perfect,
  "privacy-sens-lte-1"=privacy + privacy_sens_lte_1,
  "privacy-data-ind"=privacy + privacy_data_ind
)
for (plot in names(plots)) {
  plots[[plot]] / legend + plot_layout(heights=c(6, 1))
  ggsave(sprintf("plots/metrics_%s.pdf", plot), dpi=300, height=8, width=7)
  ggsave(sprintf("plots/metrics_%s.png", plot), dpi=300, height=8, width=7)
}
```

```{r reg-eps-viz}
models_dummies[[1]] %>%
  tidy() %>%
  filter(grepl("epsilon_str", term)) %>%
  mutate(
    # convert epsilon to linear scale
    # epsilon_str looks like epsilon_str[number].[number]e[exponent]
    epsilon=term %>% str_replace("epsilon_str", "") %>% as.numeric(),
    ymin=ci_lb(estimate, std.error, alpha=0.1),
    ymax=ci_ub(estimate, std.error, alpha=0.1),
    sig=ifelse(p.value >= 0.1, "Not sig.", "Sig. @ p < 0.1"),
    term = fct_reorder(replace_backticks(term), -p.value)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=epsilon, y=estimate, ymin=ymin, ymax=ymax)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, lty = 2) +
  geom_point(aes(fill=sig), shape=21) +
  geom_errorbar() +
  scale_x_continuous(trans='log10', breaks=c(1e-5, 1e-4, 0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10, 100, 1000)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("white", "black"), name="") +
  theme +
  theme(legend.position="right") +
  ylab("Coefficient") +
  xlab(expression(epsilon))
ggsave("plots/reg_epsilon_dummies.pdf", width=6, height=3)
ggsave("plots/reg_epsilon_dummies.png", width=6, height=3)
```

```{r cross-sections}
  "time_index_abbrv",
  "geographic_index_abbrv",
  "claim_in_abstract",
  "dv_rq_importance_abbrv",
  "all_noised",
  "epistemic_claim"
)) {
  print(
    dot_means(results_latest_dp_middle, "epistemic_match", "epsilon_str", v, min_results=min_results, facet_label_width=if (v == "geographic_index_abbrv") 60 else NULL) + ylab("Rate of strict parity") +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks=c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1)) +
    xlab(expression(epsilon))
  )
  save(v)
}

df_vars = results_latest_dp_middle %>%
  inner_join(variables_metadata, by=pk_results)

print(df_vars %>% select(starts_with("query_type")))

for (v in c(
  "query_type_abbrv",
  "query_type_simple",
  "reg_role",
  "data_type_abbrv",
  "interaction_variable"
)) {
  print(dot_means(df_vars, "epistemic_match", "epsilon_str", v, min_results=min_results) + ylab("Rate of strict parity") +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks=c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1)) +
    xlab(expression(epsilon))
  )
  save(v)
}

df_data_domain = df_vars %>%
  expand_data_domain() %>%
  drop_na(data_domain_abbrv) %>%
  filter(epsilon < 100, epsilon > 0.001)
dot_means(df_data_domain, "epistemic_match", "epsilon_str", "data_domain_abbrv", min_results=min_results, sample_sizes=F, bar=T) +
        ylab("Rate of strict parity") +
    xlab("Type of data") +
    scale_fill_brewer(
      palette=palette_sequential,
      direction=1,
      name=expression(epsilon)
    ) +
    guides(
      "fill"=guide_legend(title=expression(epsilon))
    )
save("data_domain", h=5, w=7)

df_jel_1 = results_latest_dp_middle %>%
  left_join(results_latest_jel_1, by="study_id", relationship="many-to-many") %>%
  drop_na("jel_description_1_abbrv") %>%
  filter(epsilon < 100, epsilon > 0.001)
dot_means(df_jel_1, "epistemic_match", "epsilon_str", "jel_description_1_abbrv", min_results=min_results, ncol=2, sample_sizes=T, bar=T) +
  ylab("Rate of strict parity") +
  xlab("Top-level JEL category") +
  scale_fill_brewer(
    palette=palette_sequential,
    direction=1,
    name=expression(epsilon)
  ) +
  guides(
    "fill"=guide_legend(title=expression(epsilon))
  )
save("jel", h=5, w=7)
```
